title: Advance wishes (case-db, versioned consent)
description: What the customer chose while well: who to tell, when a cooling-off pause applies, and what may be disclosed. Versioned; a new version supersedes the old one. Changes made while a case is open are frozen for review (DA 12).

frozen_reason.description: Set when a change was attempted during an open case; the previous contact is notified.

readback_confirmed.description: The policy was read back in plain Japanese and the customer confirmed it.

phone_verified_at.description: Verified at registration (e.g. SMS code). Locked while a case is open.

phone_changed_at.description: A recent change is a 'contact suspected' trigger.

cooling_off.description: A pre-agreed delay, not a prohibition (R5, 2026-10-12). Applied by the teller. Needs legal review.

minimum_hours.description: Fixed minimum so a late-afternoon visit isn't a 30-minute pause (CR 25).

extend_to_next_business_day_close.description: Pause ends at the later of minimum_hours and next business day close...

override.description: How the customer can end the pause early (R5).

disclosure.description: What the trusted contact may be told. The balance and account numbers are not options, so they can never be disclosed.

outbound_notice_consent.description: Consent to the outbound notice ('Branch X calling about your mother, please call back'), which is itself a small disclosure (CR 15).
